schema_version.description: Document version. The local file's value is ignored.

plugins.description: Plugin entries by plugin id. Every entry takes `enabled` (default `true`), `on_error` and `timeout_sec`; a plugin that calls an agent also takes `agent` (a named agent or an inline one) and `description`. Other fields belong to the plugin. Sessions freeze every entry except an advisory plugin; a local layer may set `enabled: false`. Example: `plugins: { my_plugin: { enabled: true } }`.
